ev.q: Medical chart abstraction, using a standard case report form, was conducted for 198 persons
Among the 173 outpatients, 41 (24%) had an underlying medical condition
Most patients reported subjective fever (95%), cough (68%), and runny nose (61%).
17 (10%) had a complication associated with their infection, and 122 (71%) were prescribed influenza antivirals.
Of the 198 patients in the investigation, 95% were aged <18 years
Among 25 hospitalized patients, 14 (56%) had an underlying medical condition
In November 2019, a field investigation was conducted to characterize the early influenza B virus–associated illnesses in Louisiana

methods_quotes.q: Some patients had more than one underlying medical condition.
